lines: Increases attack power, critical strike chance, armor and dodge chance.

title: Intellect
lines: Increases maximum mana and the chance to land a critical strike with spells.

title: Spirit
lines: Increases mana regeneration while not casting.

title: AttackPower
lines: Increases the damage of melee attacks and abilities that scale with attack power.

title: RangedAttackPower
lines: Increases the damage of ranged attacks.

title: SpellPower
lines: Increases damage and healing done by spells and effects.

title: MP5
lines: Mana restored every 5 seconds, even while casting.

title: MeleeHit
lines: Lowers the chance for attacks and spells to miss. Forever gear gives hit as a flat percent: 10 hit rating is 1%.

title: MeleeHitDown
lines: Losing hit: how much DPS this preset would give up with 1% less hit.

title: MeleeCrit
lines: Raises the chance to land a critical strike with attacks and spells. 14 crit rating is 1%.
